sources.label: Free-time patches for apps
sources.author: RabehX
patch_list: Removes the screen capture block so screenshots and recordings work.
Fixes screen freezing after resuming the app from the background.

Removes Google Play's PairIP anti-tamper wrapper so the app runs without license checks. Restores the original Application class in the manifest, removes all injected com.pairip.* components, and neuters PairIP's license client.
